config.framework: golden price/time + market + full board distribution + current/captured leaders + individual

preprocessing.ridge: train-only median/mean/std plus all per-field missing indicators
preprocessing.lightgbm: native NaN plus all per-field missing indicators

output_policy.primary: clip raw predictions to [0,1], physical amplitude not probability
output_policy.raw: persist float64 and report raw errors/bound violations; never pick representation from test

evaluation.primary: MSE and paired LightGBM minus Ridge / train mean
secondary: mean observed downside at equal retention versus analytical random

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap by observed trading date

prospective_validation.start: first trading day strictly after actual model weight freeze; no retrospective backfill

config.artifact_policy: gzip lossless LightGBM text, two float64 raw prediction columns, no copied feature matrix

authorization.approval_context: 用户在真实34列候选侧表独立验收通过后，对明确下一步绑定侧表完成训练入口验收、再执行一次固定Ridge/LightGBM对照的交付回复继续；本轮先验收入口，通过后仅各模型一次。不复用旧一次性授权。
